qa_pairs.question: How do you upload and download files to a Nextcloud remote using the `rclone` command-line tool?
qa_pairs.answer: To upload a file, run `rclone copy /path/to/local/file nextcloud:remote/path`. To download a file, run `rclone copy nextcloud:remote/path/file .`.

qa_pairs.question: How can users share files within Nextcloud with other Alliance account holders or with individuals who do not have an Alliance account?
qa_pairs.answer: To share with other Alliance users or groups, type their first name, last name, username, or CCDB group name when selecting a file or directory to share. To share with non-Alliance account holders, use the 'Share link' option and provide their email address; Nextcloud will send an email notification with a link to access the file.
